newsitem.title: USA: Fleet says R.I. project to create 2,000 jobs.
newsitem.headline: Fleet says R.I. project to create 2,000 jobs.

text.p: Fleet Financial Group Inc said Thursday it signed an agreement with the state of Rhode Island to build a regional service center in Lincoln, R.I., that it said would create 2,000 jobs over the next five years.
The center will be located in a 17-acre former distribution facility of A.T. Cross Co, the pen maker, Fleet said. It will invest $15 million to buy and renovate the facility, it said.
Fleet said its expansion in Rhode Island, in which it already employs 3,000, was facilitated by a financing package from the state's Economic Development Corp.
Under the agreement, Fleet said the development agency plans to issue about $10 million in taxable bonds, with the proceeds to be used to buy the site and renovate the building.
Lease payments to be made by Fleet will equal the debt service on the bonds, estimated to be $1.0 million annually, it said.
Fleet said it will receive a job incentive credit against the rent payments of $1,000 per employee per year for each additional employee hired over an initial 1,000 employees.
The additional employees can work at any Fleet site in the state, it said.
